zpa._comment: Per-fleet config. Override with -c zpa:<key>=<value> or edit here. account/region/vpcId/privateSubnetIds are REQUIRED.
zpa._comment_dnsServerCidrs: IPv4 CIDRs for DNS egress (UDP/TCP 53). Empty (default) = the VPC CIDR, which covers the in-VPC Route 53 Resolver. List your DNS server IPs as /32s when the VPC DHCP options use DNS servers outside the VPC.
zpa._comment_encryptionKeyType: Secret + log group (and SNS topic + DLQ) encryption. 'customer-managed' (DEFAULT) = one dedicated KMS CMK with annual rotation, self-owned and auditable (~$1/mo/key); clears the CKV_AWS_149 / SECRETSMANAGER_USING_CMK / CLOUDWATCH_LOG_GROUP_ENCRYPTED review findings with no exception. 'aws-managed' = opt-out to AWS-owned/managed keys (aws/secretsmanager + AWS-owned CloudWatch Logs key + aws/sns + SQS-managed), no extra cost but the CMK findings reappear as accepted exceptions.
